# Version 4.151.0
> **Skia m151 with managed perf wins** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 updates to Skia m151 and ports several hot P/Invoke paths to managed code. Color and premultiply conversions, HarfBuzz buffer encoding, and tag parsing all move off native round-trips for lower overhead. It also fixes a native resource leak and a CPU raster regression.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m151** — Brings the bundled Skia engine up to the m151 upstream release line, plus the ongoing chrome/m151 bug-fix merges throughout the preview cycle. ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294), [#4312](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4312), [#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382), [#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443), [#4489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4489))

## API Surface

- **Span overloads for hex color parsing** — SKColor hex parsing is optimized and gains ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads for allocation-free parsing. ([#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native resource leak in SKImage fixed** — Fixes a native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI). ([#3997](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3997))
- **CPU raster regression fixed** — Restores SK_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHADERCONTEXT to fix a CPU raster rendering regression introduced by the engine update. ([#4428](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4428))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Hot paths ported to managed code** — SKColor-to-SKColorF conversion, single-value SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply, HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8, HarfBuzzSharp.Tag.Parse, SKFourByteTag.Parse, and SKShaper glyph reads now avoid P/Invoke round-trips and per-call allocations. ([#4370](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4370), [#4385](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4385), [#4376](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4376), [#4408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4408), [#4396](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4396), [#4388](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4388))
- **Unnecessary unsafe modifier removed** — Removes an unnecessary unsafe modifier from GRContextOptions. ([#3991](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3991))

## Platform

- **WASM Emscripten 5.0.6 support for .NET 11** — Adds Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries built with the new exnref exception handling for .NET 11, plus a preview-.NET WASM test job to catch exception-handling regressions. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4459](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4459), [#4487](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4487), [#4488](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4488))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Makes Buffer.AddUtf8(string) allocation-free with a pooled UTF-8 encode and removes a per-call allocation from Tag.Parse.
